text:
alex: heads up — we're getting reports that incident pages didn't reach oncall for recent alerts. noticed a batch of ACK-less pages in the incidentbot retry queue (shards 4/7) around 12:03 UTC. anyone else seeing this?
maria: I see spikes in the incidentbot outbound queue metrics, long tail latency on http_post to pagerflow. logs show 429s then retries.
zane: paging gateway also shows connection churn to pagerflow.edge, TLS handshakes failing intermittently. linking logs: `ERR_TLS_HANDSHAKE` repeated.
incident-bot: (system) triggered automatic retry window for 24 alerts, policy=expbackoff, last_retry=7923456760, next_retry=7923456920.
alex: customer impact = delayed pages. ops reported one support case where pager notification arrived ~8m late. not widespread but could be bigger.
ops-shift: manual workaround - please don’t rely on auto-ack. if you see critical, use manual SMS ringaround (team oncall list) until we have fix.
maria: attempting a soft restart of incident-bot worker shard-4 to drain stuck connections. will post status in 30s.
deploy-bot: deploy started: incident-bot/shard4 restart (rolling) by maria @ 12:07 UTC.
zane: also rolling certs? pagerflow recently rotated a CA yesterday; our clients might not like the intermediate. checking tls cert chain.
alex: maria — if restart doesn't clear retries, can you flush the outbound queue for shard-4 and move alerts to shard-6?
maria: restart completed. worker reconnected and began to re-enqueue retries. outbound queue length dropped from 420 -> 18 within ~45s.
incident-bot: (system) alert delivery status: 18 pending retries, 6 delivered, 0 failed permanently.
ops-shift: confirming manual SMS ringaround used once — no escalations missed beyond that one ~8m delay.
zane: patched TLS CA bundle on gateway -> revalidated connections to pagerflow.edge. handshake errors stopped at 12:09.
alex: ok — root cause looks like a cert-chain/handshake regression on a subset of connections causing exponential retry fan-in and queue starvation on certain shards -> delayed pages.
maria: action items: 1) follow up with pagerflow eng to confirm cert rotation compatibility (assigned to zane). 2) add safer backoff cap for incident-bot to avoid starving other shards (assigned to maria). 3) postmortem if customer case escalates (assigned to alex).
zane: filed ticket PF-8821 to Pagerflow with logs + trace ids.
alex: thanks — marking this thread for incident follow-up. ping me if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
ops-shift: closing manual ringaround as of 12:14 UTC. will keep an eye on paging SLOs for next 24h.
incident-bot: (system) thread closed by alex @ 7923457015.
